effects: Exactly `assets` PYUSD leave the signer for the vault, using the signer's existing PYUSD allowance to the vault (ERC4626._deposit safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, address(this), assets)).
The vault mints steakPYUSD shares to `receiver`. The number of shares comes from the vault's exchange rate after fees accrue, and there is no minimum.
The vault supplies the PYUSD to Morpho markets. This changes nothing else for the signer.
formats.shown: Intent 'Deposit', with the PYUSD amount, the share ticker steakPYUSD and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares received is not shown; the vault's exchange rate sets it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol deposit: shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Floor). The value is not in the calldata. Case 0: 91.976 steakPYUSD came in, and the screen shows only the ticker.
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. A 'Share ticker' label like 'Receive shares (amount set by vault rate)' could say so.

findings.title: deposit: the bare intent 'Deposit' names neither the asset, the amount nor the vault.

cases.notes: 100 PYUSD out is shown right. steakPYUSD in is shown with its ticker and recipient but no amount, which cannot come from calldata.

effects: PYUSD leaves the signer for the vault, using the signer's allowance. The amount is computed from `shares` at the vault rate, rounded up, and has no maximum.
Exactly `shares` steakPYUSD are minted to `receiver`, which may be an address other than the signer.
formats.shown: Intent 'Mint', with the ticker 'PYUSD' as the deposit asset (no amount), the number of steakPYUSD shares minted and the address that receives them.

findings.title: mint: the PYUSD amount the signer pays is not shown and has no bound.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol mint: assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Ceil). The value comes from storage. Case 1: 2 PYUSD units left the signer, and the screen shows only 'Deposit asset: PYUSD'.
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. Relabel to 'Pay with (amount set by vault rate)'.

findings.title: mint: the intent 'Mint' does not say that the signer pays PYUSD into the vault.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json mint intent "Mint", no interpolatedIntent. The code pulls PYUSD from the caller (ERC4626._deposit safeTransferFrom).
findings.fix: Use intent 'Deposit PYUSD for shares' and interpolatedIntent "Mint {shares} for {receiver}, paying PYUSD".

cases.notes: PYUSD out: the asset and the vault are understood, but no amount is shown. The shares went to 0xdead, not to the signer, and the screen shows that correctly.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns steakPYUSD shares from `owner`. The number is computed from `assets` at the vault rate, rounded up, and has no maximum.
When the signer is not `owner`, the owner's share allowance to the signer is spent.
formats.shown: Intent 'Withdraw', with the exact PYUSD amount, the recipient and the owner of the shares.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of shares burned from the owner is not shown; the vault's rate sets it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol withdraw: shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, ..., Ceil); ERC4626._withdraw _burn(owner, shares).

findings.title: withdraw: the bare intent 'Withdraw' does not say that steakPYUSD shares are burned for PYUSD.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: Exactly `shares` steakPYUSD are burned from `owner`. When the signer is not the owner, the owner's allowance to the signer is spent.
PYUSD is sent to `receiver`. The amount is computed from `shares` at the vault rate, rounded down, and has no minimum.
formats.shown: Intent 'Redeem', with the number of steakPYUSD shares, the recipient and the owner. Neither the asset received nor its amount is shown.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never names PYUSD as the token received, though mint shows it as a constant.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json redeem fields: only shares, receiver, owner. Case 2: 10019.854410 PYUSD came in to the signer, and no field mentions PYUSD. The reader wrote 'presumably PYUSD'.

findings.title: redeem: the PYUSD amount received is not shown and has no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol redeem: assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, ..., Floor). The value comes from storage. Case 2: 10019.85 PYUSD in.

findings.title: redeem: the bare intent 'Redeem' names neither the shares nor what comes back.

cases.notes: The shares out are shown exactly. The PYUSD in is shown neither by asset nor by amount; the reader guessed the asset.
